sentences.text:
And  In the matter of: Md. Anjul Sk @ Md. Aanjul Sekh  ....petitione  Mr. Kalidas Saha  ...for the petitioner  Ms. Z. N. Khan  Mr. Arup Sarkar  ...for the State  1.
Heard the learned Counsel for both the parties.
2. Charge-sheet having been filed, trial has commenced and the victim has already been examined.

entities.text: Md. Anjul Sk @ Md. Aanjul Sekh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Considered the materials placed by learned Counsel for the parties including the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
4. Regard being had to the facts and submissions in the case, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner and present stage of the trial, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Judge, Special Court, Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Malda in POCSO Case No.
120 of 2017 arising out of Kaliachak P.S. case No. 883 of 2014 on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case.

entities.text: Special Court, Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Malda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

6. CRM (DB) 2293 of 2023 is disposed of.
(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
